raw_text: Sources on the ground in Tigray confirm Eritrean checkpoints active near Adwa and Shire as of this morning. Local contacts report military convoys moving south from the border. Situation remains tense with no signs of withdrawal. Humanitarian corridors still blocked in several areas. Will update as more information comes in.
